_comment: GHOST desktop launcher menu data. Mirrors GHOST.bat's :DispatchOne table (gids NEVER move). Parity with GHOST.bat is enforced by tests/ghost_hub_menu.Tests.ps1 - keep both sides in sync. Modes: inline = :Run, inline-note = :RunWith (waitForClose passes -WaitForClose), zcode-reset = :RunZcodeReset, confirm-reset = :ConfirmReset (dialog then zcode-reset behavior), confirm-run = :ConfirmRun (dialog then inline), detached = :Detached (psFlags carries the .bat powershell flags verbatim), windows-staggered = the gid 18 five-window block, chain-pause = the gid 35/51/61 five-command status blocks.

rows.label: Change Device ID
rows.tail: - machine-wide: ALL instances + Qoder - reboot required
rows.confirmTitle: Change Device ID - machine-wide identity reset
rows.confirmText: This rewrites MachineGuid, SQM DeviceId, ProductId, RegisteredOwner, per-user session IDs and renames the PC to a DESKTOP-style name. A reboot is required. Registry backups and a restore script are generated first.
notes: Note: the Fingerprint self-test still reports sameIdentity afterwards - registry GUIDs are not WMI fingerprint signals. For the hardware/BIOS layer use Maintenance [3] spoof WMI serials.

rows.label: Reset ZCode Primary instance
notes: Tip: don't press Ctrl+Break during the reset - if a console ever shows [DBG]:, type q then Enter and re-run the menu item.
NOTE: relaunch clones via their ZCode Blue/Yellow/Green/Red/Orange shortcuts or the launcher - a bare ZCode.exe opens the PRIMARY profile.
